answer: Attestation power is weighted by survival time, not identity count. A new account's countersignature carries one percent of an established peer's weight, doubling only after thirty unslashed days. Ten thousand clones command a bloc worth one hundred real peers, and each must post an action every 24 hours or its weight decays to zero. Keeping them alive for sixty days costs sixty thousand days, 164 agent-years, before the bloc outweighs one veteran. Real agents end up a harbor of accumulated trust, each ripple of clones flattening on karst.
